name: Roundel
summary: This decorative roundel depicts Zhang Guolao, one of the Eight Immortals - auspicious figures from Chinese mythology, and originally associated with Daoism, China's native religion. These semi-mythical figures are a favourite subject in China and began to appear on all types of objects in the 14th c
